observations.trace: For a source-only hypothetical Market with four (0,0) finite corners and Fieldstone surface, is_valid checks only finite corners. convex_quad_contains sees four zero-length edges, so each perpendicular determinant is zero and it returns true for a distinct finite point such as (1,1). The current urban source validator invokes this is_valid check. A separately constructed hypothetical UrbanGroundLookup indexes the zero-size market into bucket (0,0); (1,1) is also in that 32-metre bucket, so the shown lookup would suppress grass there and its surface query would select bare Road. SceneGround.ground_at first requires the point within its grid. The market, lookup, scene, query and scalar operations were not constructed or executed.
observations.remaining: Current reassessment of the original059 Adler finding, with original attribution and later qualifications preserved. Direct leaf contains yields true for arbitrary finite points, but urban lookup consults only indexed buckets: the ground-consumer example is local to bucket (0,0), not a whole-map result. Scene input load validates other source and grounding contracts; a fully admitted scene containing this market and any actual producer or gameplay outcome have not been established. The ordinary graph obtains market corners from a block, not this invented input. A furniture market frame begins with the first edge and may skip zero-vector orientation under the stated native sqrt assumptions; do not infer placed market stalls from the direct containment result. Yard finite/area admission versus convex ordering is a distinct open question.

observations.trace: Garden geometry checks whether any street contains the first route start; normal garden compilation and compound street connection also use the direct predicate without this urban-ground bucket. A degenerate Market predicate may satisfy that individual test for a distant finite point.
observations.remaining: Do not infer a complete passing garden, compound, loaded scene or generated city from one condition; all other geometry, ownership and connection checks still apply.

observations.trace: Furniture candidate acceptance tests market containment, but the market-frame producer first derives orientation from edge 0–1. Pinned glam try_normalize rejects a zero vector if its length reciprocal is nonfinite under an available ordinary sqrt backend; backend dispatch not resolved. Furniture route reservations and rendering have separate paths.
observations.remaining: No generated stall, collider, report, renderer, native target feature or runtime behavior was observed.
